units.en: This ⟦0⟧ requires ⟦1⟧ complete the focus ⟦2⟧, become leader of a faction and release ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧, ⟦6⟧ and ⟦7⟧. A faction member has to control the Greater London Area as well.

The focus ⟦0⟧ has not worked correctly since ⟦1⟧, so disabling that DLC is best when attempting these strategies. Otherwise, you'll need to manually justify a war goal on the ⟦2⟧, which will cause World Tension. Additionally, neither strategy takes into account ⟦3⟧'s supply system revamp. You may need to build naval bases along the coast while advancing in Africa, particularly in the second strategy. If you don't, you'll bleed yourself out of manpower far too quickly to recover from.

Immediately research marines, submarines, and naval invasions. Build a large submarine fleet and naval dockyards. Follow the focus tree to become ⟦0⟧ and get the Anti Colonialist Focus once free from the ⟦1⟧. Prepare naval invasions to the ⟦2⟧ territories in Africa, leading to the ⟦3⟧ mainland in Europe. Prepare defensive units on the ⟦4⟧ border. Head to ⟦5⟧ in the focus tree.
With the ⟦0⟧ start one Heavy Cruiser. It should finish by the time you declare war on Portugal. Do not build any submarines till you research level 3 submarines.

Now for the army, start training the cheapest infantry (consisting of 3 infantry) divisions in batches of 3. Convert all your infantry brigades to this template. Later convert 6 of them to the marine template.

Plan your naval invasions. You should be able to conquer Portugal by mid or late 1938. They would have shipped most of their brigades to their colonies if you have set up an army plan there. While naval invading keep your subs away and use only the HC and 2 subs.

After ⟦0⟧, rush ⟦1⟧ with all your marine troops. ⟦2⟧ hardly has a navy. Remember to set up the mainland army around Belgian Congo. With the rest of the marines and a few normal troops, naval invade a ⟦3⟧ port and one of its adjacent non-port provinces. ⟦4⟧ is not too hard to capitulate as they too send their troops over to Africa if you set up a small army along their border. Once the Belgian war is done, set up along the British border with your small army. You should have trained about 30 brigades by now.

Prepare to naval invade Britain by building one or two more heavy cruisers. Wait for Germany to initiate WWII. Also do not bother with ⟦0⟧ lands but instead keep your marines (about 25 divisions) and navy in Belgian port. Convert half of your marine force to paratroopers.

Go to war with the ⟦0⟧, once ⟦1⟧ is pushing up along the French border and has taken out the Netherlands. Make paradrop orders on French provinces (you require only a few provinces) to capitulate France. Now check the air map to see if you can get air superiority in the English region. If lucky, paradrop. Otherwise, plan a naval invasion of the ⟦2⟧. When the invasion force is ready bring out your massed fleets of HC and subs. The British Navy may end up sinking the entire South African fleet but it would give you enough time and naval superiority to land your marines. Try to snag both Norfolk and Dover. Once you have a port bring your entire army up there. Britain does not keep many troops in its homelands and you can rush the northern and Scottish provinces. Capitulate the ⟦3⟧ and take its colonial holdings in Africa. Remember to take the Greater London Area as it is necessary for the achievement.
⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ both need to be disabled for this strategy.

Follow the focus tree to down the ⟦0⟧ path, and to fill in infrastructure focuses as you wait for enough Communist influence to meet prerequisites of focuses. After ⟦1⟧, appoint a Communist demagogue and prepare for civil war. Before triggering the civil war, delete all but one unit and place it in Natal province ready to rush Cape Town - that will lead to a quick victory.
Once under ⟦0⟧ control, start boosting party popularity in ⟦1⟧.

Add Support Artillery to the District Force template and build some Cavalry. Set 3-4 District Force on the border with ⟦0⟧ and the rest of your military on ⟦1⟧. Trigger war with ⟦2⟧ through the ⟦3⟧ focus. Attack through ⟦4⟧ and once you have enough of the territory take the Freedom for Mozambique event. When all Portuguese troops are eliminated, move to attack ⟦5⟧ and onward through ⟦6⟧ (using the ⟦7⟧ focus). You want to make sure you finish up ⟦8⟧ early enough so the war with ⟦9⟧ does not trigger the allies against you before you can set up your attack on ⟦10⟧ colonies.

Along the way, take the "Freedom for ..." events as you meet the conditions. After 180 days, you get the options to puppet or have an independent in your faction (We welcome them with open arms!). Never puppet them, and never accept their request to join wars. They will serve as barriers to the ⟦0⟧ in your upcoming war with them.

After ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ are independent, put enough troops on the southern border with ⟦2⟧ (leave the side with your ⟦3⟧ territory open) to hold back the British. Put the rest of your troops (having some cavalry is helpful) in southwest ⟦4⟧, just north of the part the juts into ⟦5⟧. Timing is important here, you want to attack from ⟦6⟧ with about 10 days before you make them independent. If you are too early, the British and French will take enough land to prevent independent ⟦7⟧, too late and you will not gain your foothold in ⟦8⟧ in time.

Once in ⟦0⟧, timing becomes important to take ⟦1⟧ before the Italians (you can't fight the Axis in this strategy). Push up to the chokepoint between Lake Malawi and Lake Tanganyika to cut off the British to the south. You can start attacking them through ⟦2⟧ (you may have to release ⟦3⟧ if they get too far in there before you cut them off, but that is ok). Move to the northern border of ⟦4⟧ to open a supply route, and up to ⟦5⟧. Take and hold the port at Mombasa and the capital Nairobi for 180 days until you are able to make it independent through the event. Also make ⟦6⟧, ⟦7⟧, ⟦8⟧, ⟦9⟧, and ⟦10⟧ independent along the way.

At this point, all the colonies needed for the achievement are liberated and you should have enough influence to stage a coup in ⟦0⟧ (West Midlands is a good location since it is near London). This takes several months and uses a lot of guns. While waiting, get military access from ⟦1⟧ and move troops to a port in northwest ⟦2⟧. When the coup triggers, Communist ⟦3⟧ will ask to join your faction (if it is early enough in the game, later they will join ⟦4⟧). Transport your troops to Cardiff and push on London. Once you have it, the achievement triggers.

Timing is critical in this strategy, and you need to launch your attacks when you have just enough troops to succeed. Getting to ⟦0⟧ before ⟦1⟧ is key. You also need the ⟦2⟧ coup early enough so they don't join ⟦3⟧. Build up factories and grab the ⟦4⟧ focus so you can build enough guns for your troops and the coup. You don't need a navy for this one since you aren't doing any naval invasions.
…and you get a canton, everybody gets a canton!
